parts.note_add: This is the spot (map) half of wiring-diagram device H-06 'Interior and spot light' (S-001 PDF p.26): constant LY feed, its own on/off switch, bulb to case ground; the existing unassigned S-001 spec 'Spot (map) light 6 W' belongs to this lamp. Catalogue figure 6900A-3 (S-005 Body PDF p.130) draws it inside the W/MAP LAMP interior mirror, GS and GSL only.

Figure 6900A-3 (S-005 Body PDF p.130) shows socket 51354 carrying the wedge bulb 69170K (0000-11-0194, PT962), not the 10 W festoon 69170J; PT961's parent should probably be PT957 and PT962's PT959 - confirm on the car.
Still sold new as Mazda FA01-51-351A (Atkins Rotary, USD 41.50, fits 1981-85); reproductions are also listed on eBay.

Figure 6900A-3 draws 69170J as a festoon in the mirror body, present with or without the map lamp, so it is the interior (dome) lamp bulb; trade DE3175 (10 W, SV8.5 festoon) matches the catalogue rating. The 1982 wiring diagram labels the interior lamp 5 W, not 10 W - confirm the bulb in the car.

Figure 6900A-3 draws 69170K as a wedge bulb in socket 51354, so this is the map (spot) lamp bulb; Mazda 0000-11-0194 is the trade-194 wedge (3.4/3.8 W elsewhere in S-005), while S-001 labels the spot lamp 6 W and this row says 5 W - confirm on the car.
